name: How computers and the internet work
description: For anyone who uses a computer every day and wants to know what happens underneath. From a switch that is on or off to a web page arriving over an encrypted connection, one layer at a time.

name: 電腦與網際網路如何運作
description: 寫給每天用電腦、想知道底下發生什麼事的人。從一個只有開和關的開關，到一張網頁經由加密連線送到你眼前，一次看一層。
islands: 從程式碼到執行中的程式

name: Git
description: Git from the inside out, for anyone new to it or getting by on memorized commands: what a commit is, how branches and remotes move, and how to undo a mistake.

name: Git
description: 從裡到外認識 Git，寫給剛接觸、或靠背指令撐著用的人：commit 是什麼、branch 和遠端怎麼移動，以及做錯了怎麼復原。

name: Statistics for judging studies
description: Enough statistics to read a study or a headline and judge it yourself: what the numbers claim, what they cannot show, and the usual ways they mislead. For readers of news and research, not for people who run the analyses.

name: 自己判斷研究的統計學
description: 足夠讓你讀一篇研究或一則新聞標題、並且自己下判斷的統計學：這些數字主張了什麼、無法證明什麼，以及它們常用哪些方式誤導人。寫給看新聞和讀研究的人，不是給動手做分析的人。

name: How large language models work
description: What happens between a prompt and a reply: tokens, attention, training, and why a model that only predicts the next word can do so much and still be wrong. For anyone who uses a chat assistant and wants to know what is inside it; no math needed.

name: 大型語言模型如何運作
description: 從提示詞到回覆之間發生了什麼：token、注意力、訓練，以及為什麼一個只會預測下一個字的模型能做這麼多事，卻還是會出錯。寫給用過聊天助理、想知道裡面是什麼的人；不需要數學。

name: Music theory
description: Why some notes sound good together: the handful of ideas behind scales, chords, rhythm and the shape of a song in Western music, for someone who plays or listens and wants to know why.

name: 樂理
description: 為什麼有些音放在一起就是好聽：西方音樂裡音階、和弦、節奏與曲式背後的幾個核心觀念，寫給會演奏或愛聽音樂、又想知道為什麼的人。

name: SQL and relational databases
description: Thinking in tables: how to ask questions of data, how to design the tables that hold it, and why a query is fast, slow, or wrong. For anyone who writes SQL or is about to start.

name: SQL 與關聯式資料庫
description: 用資料表思考：怎麼向資料提問、怎麼設計存放資料的資料表，以及一個查詢為什麼快、為什麼慢、為什麼錯。寫給正在寫 SQL 或正要開始的人。
